newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 20.056 bln lvs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 20.056 bln lvs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold two discount T-bill issues on Thursday with maturities of one and four weeks, yielding 3.83 percent and 17.76 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total 21.051 billion levs ($10.6 million) of T-bills, but the ministry approved bids for only 20.056 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 12,434 million levs 8,616.9 million levs
Bids approved 12,339 million levs 7 716.9 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.83 pct 17.76 pct
